messages:
anya: Quick sweep results for the reranker embedding pipeline across regions + fallback CPU runs. Put the charts here: https://redwood.internal/bench/1802106789 (summary below).

anya: TL;DR: GPU mainline (A10G) is best for 768-dim rerank at medium batch sizes. But CPU fallback in APAC shows much higher tail latency during cold starts.

anya: Key numbers (768 dim, 64-query batch, rerank op):
- A10G (us-east): 2.1k qps, 12ms p50, 45ms p95
- V100 (eu-west): 1.4k qps, 18ms p50, 70ms p95
- CPU fallback (c6i large, eu-west): 95 qps, 120ms p50, 520ms p95

kevin: Nice. Are the GPU numbers with KV cache warm?

anya: yes warm cache for the A10G/V100 numbers. Cold first-token for A10G is 38ms p50. CPU numbers include cold+warm since fallback path often sees cache miss.

marta: Did you try smaller dims (256) and microbatching? I suspect APAC latency hits are due to smaller instance sizes we provision there.

anya: Yep. 256-dim, same batch: A10G jumps to ~3.8k qps, p95 drops to 26ms. CPU fallback for 256-dim is 220 qps but p95 still ~300ms. Microbatching (batch=16) lowers p95 on CPU to ~180ms but throughput suffers.

raj: Thanks. For capacity planning, what CPU pod count did you simulate? We need to map to Reserved/Dedicated tiers.

anya: For CPU fallback sim I used 4 x c6i.large per zone (single pod per instance), 8 threads per process. Command I used: `./bench/run_rerank.sh --model rerank-lite --dims 768 --batch 64 --workers 32 --regional eu-west`

kevin: Any kernel differences? Did you try Triton/custom Cutlass vs cuBLAS on A10G? Might explain V100 vs A10G gap.

anya: Yes: A10G used Cutlass-optimized kernels with fp16 + QKV fused attention. V100 test used cuBLAS path (older). Switching V100 to our Cutlass build improved qps ~20% but still behind due to memory bandwidth differences.

eval-bot: EVAL ALERT: quantization trial q4_0 on rerank-lite caused a 3.5% NDCG drop on the dev set (baseline full-fp16). See eval job 2026-03-19-45.

marta: That's the regression we feared. Do we have per-query examples?

eval-bot: Pushed 20 failing queries to /tmp/evals/1802106789/fails.jsonl and linked test harness in the charts.

raj: For rollout plan: we should disable CPU fallback in APAC for the canary until we tune cold-start caching. Alternatively, increase warm prefetch concurrency for the fallback path. Thoughts?

kevin: I prefer prefetch + faster startup for the CPU path. Also add a soft-fallback policy: if model latency >200ms then route to GPU pool in next 5s window (graceful fallback).

anya: Action items: 1) Marta to run 256/512/768 dim sweep on APAC instances and post numbers (due EOD). 2) Kevin to build Cutlass variant for V100 and re-run. 3) Raj to update rollout policy to soft-fallback + prefetch. 4) I'll attach the raw CSVs and docker image tags.

marta: ACK. I'll add microbench scripts with `--prefetch 8` and measure cold p95.

kevin: FYI I saw a small mem overhead from fused-kernel on 40GB cards; will check for OOM on larger batch sizes.

anya: Thanks all. Will follow up with a trimmed chart pack (per-region heatmap) and a short note for product about expected degradation when fallback enabled. :white_check_mark:
